issues: Nothing found that gets around the measurement. The diff adds a hand-built starting layout for 30% of restarts: 4 corner circles, 12 circles spaced along the edges and 10 circles on two rings of 5, so 26 in total, which matches n. The points are randomised with a random offset, random ring angles and Gaussian jitter. It is a generic starting guess passed to the existing L-BFGS penalty optimiser, not pasted coordinates of a known packing. It uses no file access and no labels.

No bugs that would make the result meaningless. The edge positions stay within [0.09, 0.91] because L = 0.82. The points are clipped to [0.02, 0.98], and v has the expected layout of 2n coordinates followed by n radii. Validity is still enforced by the harness checker.

The restart loop stops on a 60 s wall-clock budget, so the number of restarts depends on machine speed and results are not exactly repeatable. This was already true of the incumbent and is not new in this diff.

The candidate scores -2.636 and the incumbent -2.6360, one run each. The difference is zero at the precision reported, so this is no evidence of improvement, and rejecting is consistent with the numbers. Neither side has a variance estimate from a single run, so z cannot be properly recomputed. The reported z = -0.001 is consistent with no difference.
